article.story: Western Kentucky (1-3) at New Mexico State (1-3), Oct. 1 at 8 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: New Mexico State by 1.5. Against the spread: New Mexico State 2-2, Western Kentucky 2-2. New Mexico State ranks 20th on offense, converting on 50.0% of third downs. Western Kentucky is 128th in the FBS with a -5 turnover margin. New Mexico State ranks 72nd in the FBS averaging 57.5 penalty yards per game, compared to Western Kentucky's 2nd-ranked 28.5 per-game average. Western Kentucky ranks 119th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on % of trips. New Mexico State is 115th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:53. Team leaders New Mexico State Passing: Trey Hedden, 887 yards, 5 TDs, 5 INTs, 54.3 completion percentage Rushing: James Jones, 355 yards on 57 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Tyler King, 265 yards on 18 catches, 2 TDs Western Kentucky Passing: Rodney Tisdale Jr., 543 yards, 4 TDs, 1 INT, 63.6 completion percentage Rushing: Ajay Allen, 185 yards on 50 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Jonathan Stafford Jr., 158 yards on 20 catches, 0 TDs Last game New Mexico State was defeated by New Mexico 42-18 on Sept. 26. Adam Damante passed for 162 yards on 16-of-19 attempts (84.2%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Jones carried the ball 14 times for 112 yards, adding one reception for six yards. Josiah Thomas had five receptions for 90 yards. Western Kentucky won 52-7 over Mercyhurst on Sept. 26. Tisdale led Western Kentucky with 309 yards on 19-of-23 passing (82.6%) for four touchdowns and no interceptions. Brock Glenn had 50 rushing yards on five carries and one touchdown. Nigel Johnson had one reception for 72 yards and one touchdown. Next game New Mexico State plays at Florida International on Oct. 7. Western Kentucky hosts Missouri State on Oct. 8.
